<!-- Generated by scripts/release/docs.mjs from plugin/hooks/hooks.json — edit the source, then run `node scripts/release/docs.mjs sync`. -->

Hooks are silent outside agent-kit projects and never block on their own errors.

| Event | Matcher | Script | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SessionStart` | — | `session-start.mjs` | SessionStart hook: injects the project profile (voice, language, git flow, method, work lanes), a compact knowledge index and the script index. Silent outside agent-kit projects. |
| `PreToolUse` | `Bash` | `git-guard.mjs` | PreToolUse(Bash) hook: blocks git commands the project's git flow forbids. Exit 2 blocks the call and shows stderr to Claude. Silent outside agent-kit projects. |
| `PostToolUse` | `Write` | `script-nudge.mjs` | PostToolUse(Write) hook: when the agent writes a script somewhere it will be lost (outside the project, at the project root, or in a tmp folder), remind it of the `scripts` skill so the script is found and reused next time. |
| `Stop` | — | `checkpoint.mjs` | Stop hook: after every turn (sync: async hooks are dropped when a headless run exits), saves where the work stands so the next session can resume — branch, changed files, active work. Silent; never fails. |
